summary: JPEG image decoding was improved to use a new CMYK swizzling path so CMYK JPEGs (common in printing workflows) render with correct colors instead of appearing wrong. The update also ensures a service worker that substitutes a same-origin response for a cross-origin request does _not_ taint that response, avoiding unnecessary canvas/data-access restrictions. These changes mean more accurate images and fewer false security limits when service workers are involved.
